# CareNote: Longitudinal Clinical Memory & Verifiable PaperTrail

> Medical history is not a static text chunk. It is an evolving knowledge graph across time. CareNote turns fragmented clinical encounter PDFs (discharge summaries, outpatient clinic notes, multi-column lab panels, prescriptions, and diagnostic reports) into a persistent bi-temporal patient knowledge graph, producing Longitudinal Clinical Syntheses where every single assertion is directly verifiable against the authentic source record via The PaperTrail.

## Core Architectural Thesis

Standard vector retrieval (RAG) tools slice clinical encounter records into stateless text fragments and retrieve by cosine similarity. This causes temporal blindness:
- Discontinued medications are retrieved alongside active regimens as if they coexist.
- Copy-forwarded problem list diagnoses ("chart lore") are repeated uncritically, even when refuted by subsequent diagnostic reports.
- Iatrogenic prescribing cascades are obscured as independent chronic diseases.

CareNote models patient history as an evolving bi-temporal knowledge graph where entities and assertions carry explicit validity boundaries (`valid_from` and `valid_to`, tracking `[ACTIVE]` vs. `[SUPERSEDED]` states). Every asserted clinical fact embeds an interactive source anchor (`[claim:cN]`) pointing directly to the exact source record ID, physical page number (`#page=N`), and verbatim excerpt.

## Access & Availability Model

CareNote is currently operating as a curated clinical pilot and design partner preview. Self-service automated signup is intentionally gated to ensure direct clinical calibration. 
- **Founding Clinicians & Design Partners:** Free access during the pilot phase.
- **Commercial & Practice Inquiries:** Curated onboarding via our demo intake.
- **Collaborators & Researchers:** Open collaboration for engineers and clinical informaticians.
- See full access and tier details at: https://carenote.in/pricing.md
